messages:
Daniel R: hey finance, quick weird one from my Berlin trip. Used corp card for an evening taxi on 2026-04-02. Driver gave me a tiny thermal receipt that disintegrated in my pocket. Card shows a charge 'TAXI-PAY*BER' €23.40. No VAT, no company name on slip. Can I still expense this?
Priya (Finance): hey Daniel 10f thanks for flagging. Short/no-itemization taxi receipts are common. We can accept but need manager approval + the missing-receipt declaration. Please upload a photo of the card transaction line (bank app screenshot) and fill the missing receipt form: https://intranet.redwood/finance/missing-receipt (choose "lost taxi receipt"). Also add trip details in the expense: date, pickup/dropoff, purpose (client dinner / airport transfer / etc.).
Daniel R: uploaded bank_txn.png. It shows the merchant and the amount. Trip was from Tegel station to hotel after meeting (not a client).
Sam G (Manager): approved 14f I confirm this was a business trip and the taxi was for hotel transfer. Approve reimbursement.
expense-bot: Expense record EXP-5309 created. Status: pending attachments. Next steps: attach bank screenshot, missing-receipt form, and set category = TRVL-TAXI, project = TRIP-BERLIN-0426.
Priya (Finance): one more note: for Europe taxis we accept driver receipts or bank txn + manager attestation. If the expense exceeds €50 we'd ask for more detail, but this is under threshold. We'll process in the next payroll run once the ticket is complete.
Daniel R: thanks all, just added the missing-receipt PDF and marked as manager-approved in the expense UI.
